Inbound 13:52, Ms Whitaker (ID&V passed). Calling about overdraft charges. Has been at or near the £1,200 limit since about March and 'the interest just keeps coming off'. Also 3 x £10 returned payment fees in Sept/Oct. Wants the fees and interest refunded and 'a break from it' so she can get back to zero.

Cust spoke very quietly & asked me twice to hold while she checked something. Said she was calling from work on her break. When I asked about income she said her wages go in but 'Craig deals with the money, he moves it over to his so the bills get paid' and she doesn't always know what's left. Said she doesn't have the app on her phone, he has it on his. Did not want to go through income & outgoings today, said 'not now, sorry'. I did not push.

Cust asked us NOT to send any letters to the house about this and not to call the mobile on file. Asked us to text a different number instead, 07700 900 593 (her work phone). Said 'please don't put anything about this through the door'.

I have not used the word abuse with the cust. Told her we can review the charges and that free, confidential debt advice is available, gave details. Also said we have support if anyone else is controlling her money and she can talk to us privately at any time. She said 'ok' and went quiet. Told her I am passing this to our Financial Support team, who will text the work number first to arrange a safe time to call. - S O'Brien

Returned Direct Debit fee GBP 10.00 debited 08/09/2026, 22/09/2026, 06/10/2026. Salary credit approx GBP 1,640 on 25th monthly (HOLLINGWORTH FOODS LTD). Faster Payment out same day as salary: 25/08/2026 GBP 1,500.00 to C ASHWORTH, 25/09/2026 GBP 1,550.00 to C ASHWORTH. Collections status: none. Online banking device: 1 registered device, not customer's registered mobile number.

Vulnerability record updated for Ms Whittaker (verbal consent 27/10): financial difficulty. Support needs: NO letters to home address, NO calls to mobile on file, contact by text to alt number only (work phone, added to profile). Possible economic abuse observed by handler, not disclosed by cust. Do not raise with cust unless she raises it. Referred to Financial Support.
